id: title:Gilbert09:stop a timed out job creation from leaving a running job row

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion workflow: prevents database row creation after Temporal activity timeout, avoiding orphaned terminal-state rows.
review.reason: Adds a new exception and a deadline-check helper, then uses them to prevent creating a database row when the activity has already timed out. Checks the activity's start-to-close deadline before inserting the job row; raises the new exception if the deadline has passed. Adds tests for the deadline check and the behavior when the activity times out before the row is created.
